newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria and Germany aim to boost cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Algeria and Germany aim to boost cooperation.

text.p: Algerian and German officials on Monday began a two-day meeting to boost cooperation with the adoption of some 60 joint ventures focusing on the transfer of German know-how and technology.

The Algerian official news agency APS said the Algerian- German Projects Committee, grouping officials from both countries, would assess the implementation of 27 projects worth 66 million Deutchemark ($38.3 million)
The 27 projects cover housing, fishing, vocational training and small and medium industrial units, said APS.
APS quoted foreign ministry official as saying Algeria's cooperation with Germany was expected to increase dramatically in the next few months.
